setup: Go Echo backend querying a real Postgres 16 (docker, localhost:5433), 200-row table (7 cols), oha 5s x 64 conns
notes: pgx pool is ~1.55x database/sql+lib/pq on this query and ~7x below the no-DB ceiling; the DB round-trip, not Echo, dominates once a real query is on the path. localhost Postgres - Railway private networking adds ~0.5-2ms per query.
